# Mujde app Mujde is an android app in form of Xposed module, that integrates with Xposed framework to hook apps.
Mujde lets the user manage a local repository of frida-js scripts, and select what script should it inject to which selected application.
Using android's SharedPreferences, mujde stores a map between apps to the list of scripts it should inject into them.
Using Xposed's XSharedPreferences, mujde's hook (`InjectionRequester` cls) is accessible to that mapping. Via Xposed framework, mujde gets a callback (`handleLoadPackage`) whenever an app is loaded by zygote-forkAndSpeciallize.
Then, mujde fetches the list of scripts it should inject to that app (using `XSharedPreferences`).
If that list isn't empty, mujde (`installHookOnActivityCreation`) installs hook on `Activity.onCreate` function,
Which lets us get a callback whenever a new activity is started in that app (which we already know that has scripts the user wants to inject into).
Then, from that hook, mujde sends an injection-request from the app's context to mujde's broadcast-listener named `InjectionRequestHandler`. That handler sends parses the injection-request via intent,
And creates `frida-inject` subprocesses (as root user) to inject the selected scripts into the started app.
NOTE that the scripts will be re-injected whenever the app creates/re-creates any activity. Mujde manages the local scripts repository in the app-data folder's `files` subfolder.
Users with root permissions can create/remove/edit files from that folder directly,
Without using mujde's app to manage the repository: `/data/data/com.rel.mujde/files/scripts`
This feature is extremly usable for scripts / massive management operations on the repository. Additional, mujde's shared-preferences are stored at Xposed-shared-preferences folder to be world-readable.
Root users can edit the shared-preferences from there to import settings from other devices,
And any user can read the contents of that folder and files. Mujde's main shared-pref can be found at `/data/misc/eb08c078-3e01-43a8-8857-4e57e0f0e2e3/prefs/com.rel.mujde/mujde_prefs.xml`.
NOTE that this path might have a different guid on different android devices / between reboots. ## Compile The App Use this guide to compile the app by yourself (or simply download the build artifacts from github-action or releases)
NOTE you can compile the app using windows / linux / macos ### Requirements - git client - java setup (e.g. java-temurin v21) and android-sdk - java-home (env. variable ANDROID_HOME) or local.properties set correctly with `sdk.dir` - internet connection (in order to download `frida-inject` binaries from frida's github releases) - python3 + pip + `pip install signapp buildapp && buildapp_fetch_tools` * optional, only made for release builds ### Build steps Clone the project: ```bash git clone https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.mujde mujde ``` Execute gradlew: ```bash cd mujde ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` Find the apk at `mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`
In order to build the app for release compilations: ```bash ./gradlew assembleRelease signapp -a mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk -o app-signed.apk ``` Find the apk (release build) at `app-signed.apk` ## Install The App The app is implemented in form of Xposed module, therefore MUST be installed on devices with Xposed-framework, like LSposed/EdXposed.
On devices with such framework (e.g. rooted devices with LSPosed over zygisk, or virtual-LSposed over normal android/vm),
Simply install the app and enjoy hooking other apps, automatically & covertly!
If the app is installed over devices with no Xposed framework, it might simply crash when opened.
Use network guides to install LSposed / root your device, or use an emulator with similar guides. ## Code Classes ### Fragments * HomeFragment: shows home screen from navbar, the first fragment of the main activity * ScriptsFragment: show the scripts page from navbar. let the user watch existing scripts, create new, edit, delete, ... * AppsFragment: show list of apps. when app is selected, creates the ScriptSelectionActivity for chosen app (via intent's extra) ### Xposed-classes * InjectionRequester: notified when a new injectible app is loaded,
hooks it's Activity.onCreate method to broadcast a com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST request ### DATA-classes * InjectionRequest: simple data-holder to serialize/deserialize request content in Intent's extra * Constants: contains consts and strings for global needs ### Handlers * InjectionRequestHandler: handles broadcasted com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST requests, notifies the FridaInjectorService ### Utils * ScriptUtils: utils about scripts (repository, SharedPref, content, files, folder, ...) * AccessibilityUtils: chmod files / folders to make sure they are readable from other users ### Activities * ActivityMain: the activity which contains the fragments and the footer navbar * ScriptSelectionActivity: a screen where the user selects what scripts should be injected to currently selected app ### Adapters * AppListAdapter: used to list all installed apps and move to ScriptSelectionActivity to choose what scripts to inejct * ScriptCheckboxAdapter: used by ScriptSelectionActivity, to track availableScripts/selectedScripts * ScriptAdapter: used by ScriptsFragment to view each script-item (script name, edit button, delete button)

# 穆吉德应用程序 Mujde 是一款以 Xposed 模块形式存在的 Android 应用程序，它与 Xposed 框架集成以挂钩应用程序。
Mujde 允许用户管理 frida-js 脚本的本地存储库，并选择应将哪些脚本注入到选定的应用程序中。
使用 android 的 SharedPreferences，mujde 将应用程序之间的映射存储到应注入其中的脚本列表。
使用 Xpose 的 XSharedPreferences，mujde 的钩子（`InjectionRequester` cls）可以访问该映射。 通过 Xpose 框架，每当 zygote-forkAndSpecialize 加载应用程序时，mujde 都会收到回调（`handleLoadPackage`）。
然后，mujde 获取应注入到该应用程序的脚本列表（使用“XSharedPreferences”）。
如果该列表不为空，则 mujde (`installHookOnActivityCreation`) 会在 `Activity.onCreate` 函数上安装钩子，
这让我们可以在该应用程序中启动新活动时获得回调（我们已经知道该应用程序具有用户想要注入的脚本）。
然后，mujde 从该钩子将注入请求从应用程序的上下文发送到名为“InjectionRequestHandler”的 mujde 广播侦听器。 该处理程序通过意图发送解析注入请求，
并创建“frida-inject”子进程（作为 root 用户）将选定的脚本注入到已启动的应用程序中。
请注意，每当应用程序创建/重新创建任何活动时，脚本都会被重新注入。 Mujde 管理 app-data 文件夹的“files”子文件夹中的本地脚本存储库。
具有 root 权限的用户可以直接从该文件夹创建/删除/编辑文件，
不使用 mujde 的应用程序来管理存储库：`/data/data/com.rel.mujde/files/scripts`
此功能对于存储库上的脚本/大量管理操作非常有用。 另外，mujde 的共享首选项存储在 Xposed-shared-preferences 文件夹中，以便全世界可读。
Root 用户可以从那里编辑共享首选项以从其他设备导入设置，
任何用户都可以读取该文件夹和文件的内容。 Mujde 的主要共享首选项可以在 `/data/misc/eb08c078-3e01-43a8-8857-4e57e0f0e2e3/prefs/com.rel.mujde/mujde_prefs.xml` 中找到。
请注意，此路径在不同的 Android 设备上/重新启动之间可能有不同的 guid。 ## 编译应用程序 使用本指南自行编译应用程序（或者直接从 github-action 或版本下载构建工件）
注意您可以使用 windows / linux / macos 编译应用程序 ### 要求 - git客户端 - java 设置（例如 java-temurin v21）和 android-sdk - java-home（环境变量 ANDROID_HOME）或 local.properties 使用 `sdk.dir` 正确设置 - 互联网连接（为了从 frida 的 github 版本下载 `frida-inject` 二进制文件） - python3 + pip + `pip install signapp buildapp && buildapp_fetch_tools` * 可选，仅适用于发布版本 ### 构建步骤 克隆项目： ````bash git 克隆 https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.mujde mujde ```` 执行gradlew： ````bash 穆吉德 ./gradlew assemble调试 ```` 在 `mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk` 中查找 apk
为了构建用于发布编译的应用程序： ````bash ./gradlew assembleRelease Signapp -a mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk -o app-signed.apk ```` 在“app-signed.apk”中找到 apk（发布版本） ## 安装应用程序 该应用程序以 Xposed 模块的形式实现，因此必须安装在具有 Xposed 框架的设备上，例如 LSpond/EdXposed。
在具有此类框架的设备上（例如通过 zygisk 进行 LSPod 的 root 设备，或通过普通 android/vm 进行虚拟 LSpose），
只需安装该应用程序，即可自动且隐蔽地连接其他应用程序！
如果应用程序安装在没有 Xposed 框架的设备上，则打开时可能会崩溃。
使用网络指南安装 LSpose/root 您的设备，或使用具有类似指南的模拟器。 ## 代码类 ### 碎片 * HomeFragment：笑导航栏上的 ws 主屏幕，主要活动的第一个片段 * ScriptsFragment：从导航栏显示脚本页面。让用户观看现有脚本、创建新脚本、编辑、删除…… * AppsFragment：显示应用程序列表。当选择应用程序时，为所选应用程序创建 ScriptSelectionActivity （通过意图的额外） ### Xpose-类 * InjectionRequester：当加载新的可注入应用程序时收到通知，
挂钩它的 Activity.onCreate 方法来广播 com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST 请求 ### 数据类 * InjectionRequest：简单的数据持有者，用于序列化/反序列化 Intent 额外的请求内容 * Constants：包含全局需要的常量和字符串 ### 处理程序 * InjectionRequestHandler：处理广播的 com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST 请求，通知 FridaInjectorService ### 实用工具 * ScriptUtils：有关脚本的实用程序（存储库、SharedPref、内容、文件、文件夹...） * AccessibilityUtils：chmod 文件/文件夹以确保其他用户可以读取它们 ### 活动 * ActivityMain：包含片段和页脚导航栏的活动 * ScriptSelectionActivity：用户选择应将哪些脚本注入到当前所选应用程序的屏幕 ### 适配器 * AppListAdapter：用于列出所有已安装的应用程序并移动到 ScriptSelectionActivity 以选择要执行的脚本 * ScriptCheckboxAdapter：由ScriptSelectionActivity使用，用于跟踪availableScripts/selectedScripts * ScriptAdapter：被ScriptsFragment用来查看每个脚本项（脚本名称、编辑按钮、删除按钮）
